scope: General storefront search consistency and preservation of technical constraints
causes: Predictive query suggestions can change product intent
Technical numbers are treated as fuzzy text in both search paths
Normalizer infers tires from ambiguous two-number text
Preview and full results have separate retrieval logic; analytics also replaces retrieval
proposedPolicy: Parse explicit technical attributes conservatively and preserve ambiguous text
Resolve dimensions, viscosity and unambiguous product brands against existing catalog filters
Use one query plan and normal-search product source for preview and Enter
Use predictive suggestions as optional suggestions without replacing constrained product results
Keep partial attributes open; never substitute complete technical values silently
implementationRequirements: Audit catalog attribute coverage before making a field mandatory
Resolve taxonomy IDs from catalog labels instead of hardcoding them
Handle unknown construction codes and multiple measures without dropping attributes
Preserve existing user-entered syntax and incomplete identifiers
Validate compact preview latency and keyboard behavior
Include filters, locale and policy version in request/cache identity
Accept native relevance variation; do not promise byte-identical ordering
